construe_UploadRequest.description:
Upload a custom code system. The `format` field determines which additional fields are required:
- **csv**: requires `file`, `code_col`, `desc_col`
- **json**: requires either `file` (base64-encoded JSON array) or `codes` (direct JSON array)

name.description:
Name of the code system. Names are case-insensitive and stored uppercase.
Builtin system names (e.g. ICD-10-CM, SNOMED_CT_US_LITE, LOINC, CPT, etc.) are
reserved and cannot be used for custom uploads; attempts return HTTP 403 Forbidden.

file.description:
The file contents as a base64-encoded string.
For CSV format, this is the CSV file contents.
For JSON format, this is a base64-encoded JSON array; prefer using 'codes' instead.

code_col.description: Column name containing codes (required for CSV format)

desc_col.description: Column name containing descriptions (required for CSV format)

defn_col.description: Optional column name containing long definitions (for CSV format)

codes.description:
The codes to upload as a JSON array (JSON format only).
This is the preferred way to upload JSON codes, as it avoids unnecessary base64 encoding.
If both 'codes' and 'file' are provided, 'codes' takes precedence.

replace.description:
If true, replaces an existing code system with the same name and version.
Builtin systems cannot be replaced; attempts to do so return HTTP 403 Forbidden.
When false (default), uploading a duplicate returns 409 Conflict.

code_count.description: Total number of codes in the system

builtin.description: Whether this is a built-in system (vs custom uploaded)

status.description:
Processing status of the code system.
- "processing": embeddings are being generated
- "ready": code system is ready for use
- "failed": processing failed (re-upload with replace=true to retry)

created_at.description: When the code system was created

updated_at.description: When the code system was last updated

text.description: The natural language text that was used for code extraction
text.example: Patient has type 2 diabetes with hyperglycemia

id.description: The ID of the saved feedback

vocab_version.description:
OMOP vocabulary release to use for coded concept resolution. If
omitted or empty, the API uses its default release (`v20260829`).
Specify a release explicitly when reproducibility matters. The response's
`vocab_version`, when present, identifies the release used.

fhir_resources.description:
A single FHIR R4 resource or Bundle containing at least one top-level Patient.
Supported row-producing sources: Patient, Location, Organization,
HealthcareService, Practitioner, PractitionerRole, Encounter, Specimen,
DeviceUseStatement, Condition, Procedure, MedicationRequest,
MedicationStatement, MedicationAdministration, MedicationDispense,
Immunization, Observation, and AllergyIntolerance.
Medication and Device supply referenced details without independent rows;
unsupported resource types are ignored.

Each concept field submitted for vocabulary resolution supports at most
1,000 source items: each coding and any non-empty PractitionerRole.specialty
text (including whitespace-only text) count as one item. Exceeding the
per-field limit rejects the entire request with HTTP 400.

quantity_transformations.description:
Audits supplied direct quantities on emitted drug_exposure rows, including
derivations and omissions. Omitted when no applicable quantity was supplied.
Uses the response vocabulary release and does not affect terminology counts
in summary. Example concept IDs are illustrative.

rows_for_review.description:
Index of clinical rows with uncertain source status and/or primary concept 0,
following the endpoint's eligibility policy. Each entry identifies an existing
row in tables; payloads are not moved or duplicated. Omitted when empty.
Unresolved secondary units, routes, result values, or alternate codings alone
do not index a mapped row. Administrative/demographic, Specimen, and Death
rows are not indexed.

Consumers select or filter the linked table rows. If a selected row points
to a visit or detail marked for exclusion, either keep that target or clear
the row's optional visit_occurrence_id / visit_detail_id links in the load
copy. Each included detail requires its parent visit; keep that parent or
exclude the detail. Returned observation periods exclude indexed dates;
recompute them for a selected load if needed. Indexed rows may still lack
CDM-required fields.

mappings.description:
Source-coding and text outcomes linked to emitted rows. Primary concepts,
coded routes/results, supplied Quantity units, and specimen sites have
separate entries; absent units/sites have none. Text-only sites and units
can have unmapped outcomes without vocabulary resolution.

Values or routes retained outside a compatible destination column omit
omop_field and have selected: false. Demographic entries link to their
Person field or emitted race Observation. See MappingEntry for selection
and provenance semantics, and Summary for field-level counting.

device_exposure_contexts.description:
One context per source record producing device exposures, with links to all
derived rows and their shared timing, device evidence, and quantity basis.
Preserved source values may contain clinical data.

specimen_source_contexts.description:
Identity, availability, and collection timing for emitted specimens, linked
by specimen_id. Retains original timing precision/offsets and source
identifiers; source_id_path identifies the selected specimen source ID.

medication_dispense_source_contexts.description:
Supplied dispensing context linked to each emitted dispense's actual output
table and row. Omitted when no dispense is emitted. This provenance does not
establish administration or adherence.

provider_role_contexts.description:
Source context for every PractitionerRole linked to an emitted provider.
Preserves role-specific facts that the provider's singular specialty and
care-site columns cannot represent together.

dropped.description:
Supported resources that cannot produce a row because of clinical eligibility
or unusable patient, code/text, or medication evidence. Provider organizations
and roles without a confirmed individual NPI or usable Practitioner are also
reported. Unsupported resource types are ignored. Missing dates or other
CDM-required fields usually retain partial rows; see resource-specific policies
for required evidence.

Eligibility exclusions use stable resource-specific reason codes; other
shaping failures use explanatory reason text.

diagnostics.description:
Explains missing or unusable source data, unresolved links, and conflicting
or unsupported values. When an affected row is emitted, omop_table and
omop_id identify it; otherwise both are omitted. Shared issues may link to
several rows. Diagnostics can accompany retained rows or dropped resources.

outcome classifies the issue, path identifies the source field, and reason
provides context. Missing optional references do not produce diagnostics.
References resolve only against resources supplied in this request. An invalid
or unconfirmed NPI omitted from a retained Practitioner has an UNRESOLVED
diagnostic at identifier.

vocab_version.description:
The OMOP vocabulary release used for coded concept resolution
(for example, "v20260829"), for reproducibility. Omitted when no
vocabulary resolution was performed.

fhir2omop_RowForReview.description:
Metadata for one existing shaped row in tables. omop_table and omop_id
form its unique response-local row key, also used by mappings and
diagnostics. One entry per indexed row, even with multiple reasons.

source_full_url.description: Original Bundle entry fullUrl, when supplied.

source_statuses.description:
Supplied status, verificationStatus, and clinicalStatus fields copied
verbatim from FHIR, including nulls or unreadable JSON values. Missing
fields have no key. No inferred status is supplied.

fhir2omop_OmopTables.description:
OMOP CDM v5.4 rows grouped by destination table. IDs are sequential and
scoped to one response; they are not stable keys across requests.
Fields with no value are unset (omitted from the row), except concept
IDs reported as `0` and the following nullable concept fields, which are
always present: `unit_concept_id` on Measurement, Observation, and
Specimen rows, `unit_source_concept_id` on Measurement rows, and
`anatomic_site_concept_id` on Specimen rows. These nullable fields are
`null` when the source value is absent and `0` when supplied but unmapped.
Device exposure `unit_concept_id` and `unit_source_concept_id` are always
present as `null`.
Each `*_datetime` comes from the same source as its `*_date` and is set
only when that source has a time of day.

npi.description:
Single distinct confirmed individual NPI from Practitioner.identifier or,
for a role-only provider, PractitionerRole.identifier or practitioner.identifier.
Recognized systems are http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/us-npi,
urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.4.6, and 2.16.840.1.113883.4.6.
Classification trims whitespace and validates ten digits and the NPI check
digit; this field preserves the original value. Blank and UNK/UNKNOWN markers
are missing, ignoring case and surrounding whitespace. Organization, invalid,
unconfirmed, and conflicting NPIs do not populate this field.

specialty_concept_id.description: Standard Provider concept shared by every distinct supplied role specialty; otherwise `0`. Inputs resolve independently, without frequency or hierarchy selection.

gender_concept_id.description: For recorded `Practitioner.gender`, `male` and `female` resolve to validated OMOP Gender concepts. `other`, `unknown`, and absent values remain `0`.

provider_source_value.description:
The single confirmed individual NPI, including for role-only providers and
when conflicting identity attributes keep an NPI group in separate rows.
Check identity diagnostics and compatibility before deduplicating across responses.

Without an unambiguous individual NPI, the Practitioner's source identity is
used, excluding missing markers and unconfirmed NPIs. Role-only providers
require a confirmed NPI. Without a source identity, `@provider-index:N`
marks a response-local provider ordinal. Contained Practitioners use
`PractitionerRole/<role-scope>#<contained-id>`; a role without a source
identity uses `@role-index:N` as its response-local scope. These fallbacks
are not global identity guarantees; row IDs and merging are request-local.

specialty_source_value.description: Supplied specialty text (or coding display/code) when source values across roles agree, including unresolved text. Conflicting source values remain in provider_role_contexts and mappings.

specialty_source_concept_id.description: Shared input OMOP source concept when all specialties agree on both target and source concept. Text, UMLS routes, conflicting inputs, or differing source concepts leave `0`.

gender_source_value.description: The recorded FHIR administrative-gender value for this Provider.

gender_source_concept_id.description: Remains `0` because FHIR administrative-gender codes do not themselves identify OMOP source concepts.

fhir2omop_ProviderRoleContext.description: Source FHIR PractitionerRole context linked to one response-local provider row.

role_source_value.description:
The PractitionerRole source identity: its FHIR id, identifier value,
name, or fullUrl. When none is available, it is `PractitionerRole`.

practitioner_reference.description: The role's supplied practitioner reference, when present.

care_sites.description: Every organization, healthcareService, or location reference supplied by the role.

fhir2omop_ProviderRolePractitionerIdenti.description: The logical identifier supplied on a PractitionerRole's practitioner reference. Preserves unknown NPI markers even though they are ignored for identity matching.

path.description: The FHIR element path on the PractitionerRole.

gender_concept_id.description: Standard OMOP Gender concept for sex at birth, from US Core birth sex when supplied, otherwise from Patient `gender` `male` or `female`. `0` for absent, unknown, other, unsupported, or conflicting values.

month_of_birth.description: Month from Patient.birthDate, when it supplies one.

day_of_birth.description: Day from Patient.birthDate, when it supplies one.

birth_datetime.description: Not set; Patient.birthDate has no time of day.

race_concept_id.description: Standard OMOP Race concept from a US Core race OMB category; `1546847` (More than one race) when more than one distinct race resolves, with each race in an `observation` row. `0` when no category resolves.

ethnicity_concept_id.description: Standard OMOP Ethnicity concept from the US Core ethnicity OMB category. `0` when absent, unresolved, or conflicting; never derived from race.

person_source_value.description: Patient.id, or the first non-empty Patient.identifier.value when id is absent. Omitted when neither is available.

gender_source_value.description: The selected sex-at-birth source code: the US Core birth sex `valueCode`, or Patient `gender` when no birth sex is supplied. Conflicting birth sex values are joined with `|`; empty when the birth sex has no `valueCode`.

gender_source_concept_id.description: OMOP source concept of the selected sex-at-birth code, when that code is itself an OMOP source concept; `0` otherwise, as for FHIR administrative gender codes.

race_source_value.description: Every supplied US Core race category and detailed code, joined with `|` in source order, or the extension text when no code is supplied.

race_source_concept_id.description: OMOP source concept of a single resolved race code, when that code is itself an OMOP source concept; `0` otherwise, including when more than one race resolves.

ethnicity_source_value.description: Every supplied US Core ethnicity category and detailed code, joined with `|` in source order, or the extension text when no code is supplied.

ethnicity_source_concept_id.description: OMOP source concept of the resolved ethnicity code, when that code is itself an OMOP source concept; `0` otherwise.

death_date.description: Date from Patient.deceasedDateTime; unset for a boolean-only or partial value.

observation_period_start_date.description:
Earliest date selected by the source timing rules from the person's
visit and clinical rows not listed in rows_for_review, plus Specimen
and Death rows in this request. No period row is returned without
qualifying dates; not enrollment evidence.

observation_period_end_date.description:
Latest date selected by the source timing rules from the person's
visit and clinical rows not listed in rows_for_review, plus Specimen
and Death rows in this request. Includes source end dates from
unindexed rows even when the output table has no end column.
No period row is returned without qualifying dates; not enrollment evidence.

visit_source_concept_id.description: OMOP source concept for the selected Encounter.class or Encounter.type coding when available; `0` when the source coding has no OMOP source concept, including the HL7 encounter class codes listed above.

resource_id.description: Source child Encounter ID, when supplied.

full_url.description: Source child Bundle entry fullUrl, when supplied.

parent_reference.description: Supplied Encounter.partOf.reference, preserved even when grouping is not applied.

omop_table.description: Final table containing the emitted child row.

omop_id.description: Request-local ID of the emitted child row within omop_table.

fhir2omop_VisitPairAssessment.description:
Compatibility of the selected parent/detail Visit concepts under the CDM
same-concept/descendant convention. Compatible concepts must be active and
standard in the Visit domain. An assessment describes classification
compatibility, not the clinical truth of the source partOf relationship.

parent_concept_id.description: Selected parent Visit concept assessed; 0 means unresolved.

detail_concept_id.description: Selected candidate detail concept assessed; 0 means unresolved.

reason_code.description:
SAME_CONCEPT and DESCENDANT are compatible outcomes. NOT_DESCENDANT means
the usable concepts lack the required parent-ancestor/detail-descendant
relationship. Other reasons are unknown outcomes: an unresolved or unusable
concept, or insufficient ancestry evidence. Assessment unavailability or
malformed results fail the request with HTTP 500 rather than returning
an UNKNOWN result.

invalid_concept_role.description:
Identifies the unusable concept for UNKNOWN concept-validation outcomes.
Absent for ANCESTRY_UNAVAILABLE and compatible/incompatible outcomes.

min_levels_of_separation.description: Present only for compatible outcomes; 0 for identity, positive for a descendant relationship.

vocab_version.description: Concrete vocabulary version used for both selected concepts and this assessment; matches the response vocab_version.

fhir2omop_VisitDetailRow.description: An explicitly supplied component Encounter linked to its same-patient parent visit. Missing dates remain absent for downstream load completion.

visit_detail_source_concept_id.description: OMOP source concept for the selected Encounter.class or Encounter.type coding when available; `0` when the source coding has no OMOP source concept, including the HL7 encounter class codes listed above.

visit_occurrence_id.description: The emitted same-patient overarching visit referenced by this component.

condition_start_date.description: Start date selected by the source resource's timing rules. For a Condition, onsetDateTime or onsetPeriod.start, otherwise recordedDate; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

condition_end_date.description: End date selected by the source resource's timing rules, when available. For a Condition, abatementDateTime or abatementPeriod.end; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

visit_detail_id.description: Explicit same-patient component link, supplied together with its overarching visit_occurrence_id.

drug_exposure_start_date.description: Start date selected by the source resource's timing rules, such as effective[x], occurrenceDateTime, MedicationRequest.authoredOn, or MedicationDispense.whenHandedOver; see the endpoint's timing sources for all supported resources.

drug_exposure_end_date.description: End date selected by the source resource's timing rules, when available. For medication resources, an explicit effectivePeriod.end or the start date of a single-event administration or immunization; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

verbatim_end_date.description: Date from an explicit FHIR Period.end only; inferred same-day ends are not verbatim source values.

drug_type_concept_id.description: MedicationDispense uses 32825 (EHR dispensing record); MedicationRequest uses 32838 (EHR prescription). Other current resources use 32817 (EHR). These identify record provenance, not proof of medication consumption.

days_supply.description: Direct positive whole-day MedicationRequest.dispenseRequest.expectedSupplyDuration or coded UCUM-day MedicationDispense.daysSupply; never derived from drug quantity, dosage, refills, or timing. Does not derive an exposure end date.

quantity.description: Formulation-specific quantity from a direct MedicationRequest dispense quantity, MedicationDispense quantity, MedicationAdministration dose, or Immunization dose quantity. Under fixed_dose_form_count this is a matched coded tablet/capsule count copied directly, or an ingredient amount divided by per-unit strength. Under clinical_injection_ingredient_amount this is the ingredient amount, converted to the ingredient unit or derived using explicit concentration evidence; exact-unit ingredient amounts are copied directly. See the endpoint's supported dose forms and prerequisites; quantity_transformations identifies the policy, source, calculation evidence, intermediate UCUM conversion, and output unit, or explains why a supplied quantity was omitted.

sig.description: Newline-joined non-empty FHIR Dosage.text instructions in source order.

route_concept_id.description: Target-valid OMOP Route concept for an unambiguous coded FHIR route; `0` for an unmapped coded route, omitted for absent, text-only, or conflicting routes.

visit_detail_id.description: Explicit same-patient component link, supplied together with its overarching visit_occurrence_id.

route_source_value.description: Selected source coding or text for an unambiguous FHIR route.

procedure_date.description: Start date selected by the source resource's timing rules. For a Procedure, performedDateTime or performedPeriod.start; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

procedure_end_date.description: End date selected by the source resource's timing rules, when available. For a Procedure, performedPeriod.end; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

visit_detail_id.description: Explicit same-patient component link, supplied together with its overarching visit_occurrence_id.

measurement_date.description: Start date selected by the source resource's timing rules. For an Observation, effectiveDateTime, effectivePeriod.start, or effectiveInstant; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

operator_concept_id.description: OMOP "Meas Value Operator" standard concept qualifying value_as_number (<, <=, >, >=), parsed from a numeric-string value or a FHIR valueQuantity.comparator. 0 when no operator (a bare number).

unit_concept_id.description: Valid standard Unit concept for coded UCUM; 0 for supplied but unmapped units, null for absent units. Always present in JSON.

visit_detail_id.description: Explicit same-patient component link, supplied together with its overarching visit_occurrence_id.

unit_source_concept_id.description: OMOP source concept ID corresponding to Quantity.system/code; 0 for supplied units without a matching source concept, null for absent units. Always present in JSON.

unit_source_value.description: Original Quantity.code if supplied, otherwise Quantity.unit; human-readable unit text is preserved in the unit mapping's source_name.

observation_date.description: Start date selected by the source resource's timing rules. For an Observation, effectiveDateTime, effectivePeriod.start, or effectiveInstant. For an AllergyIntolerance, recordedDate, otherwise onsetDateTime or onsetPeriod.start; see the endpoint's timing sources for other resources.

unit_concept_id.description: Valid standard Unit concept for coded UCUM; 0 for supplied but unmapped units, null for absent units. Always present in JSON.

visit_detail_id.description: Explicit same-patient component link, supplied together with its overarching visit_occurrence_id.

observation_source_concept_id.description: For coded AllergyIntolerance rows, the known OMOP identity of the original coding rendered in observation_source_value, even when the finding is unresolved. 0 when no original source identity is known; the configured contextual finding is not a source concept.

unit_source_value.description: Original Quantity.code if supplied, otherwise Quantity.unit; human-readable unit text is preserved in the unit mapping's source_name.

fhir2omop_MedicationDispenseSourceContex.description:
Original dispensing context linked to an emitted clinical row by its actual
table and request-local ID, including destinations outside drug_exposure.
Preserved source values do not establish exposure duration or medication use.

full_url.description: Original Bundle entry fullUrl, when supplied.

source.description: Only supplied fields are present, using original FHIR names and values: status, statusReasonCodeableConcept, statusReasonReference, category, type, whenPrepared, whenHandedOver, daysSupply, performer, context, authorizingPrescription, dosageInstruction, and medicationReference. Raw values preserve original precision, offsets, explicit nulls, and malformed values. Presence is not a promise that a value was mapped; diagnostics explain unusable values and mappings describe coded outcomes. Direct quantities are audited separately in quantity_transformations for drug_exposure rows.

fhir2omop_QuantityTransformation.description: Audit of one supplied quantity on an emitted drug_exposure row. All evidence uses the response's vocab_version. Result and result_unit are present only for successful outcomes; reason is present only for OMITTED. Policy is present once a supported formulation policy was selected.

resource_id.description: Source FHIR resource id; empty when none was supplied.

source_path.description: Exact source element path relative to resource_type.

source_quantity.description: Original supplied Quantity object, including value, system, code, unit, comparator, and other supplied fields. Explicit nulls and malformed values are also preserved as supplied.

omop_id.description: The drug_exposure_id of the row in this response.

outcome.description: DIRECT copies a matched fixed-form count or an ingredient amount in the same unit; DERIVED converts units or calculates a dose-form count or ingredient amount under the named policy; OMITTED leaves quantity unset while retaining the row.

policy.description: The formulation policy documented in the endpoint description. May be present for an omission occurring after policy selection.

reason.description:
Stable omission reason:
- unsupported_quantity: supplied value is not a Quantity object with a positive finite numeric value.
- unsupported_comparator: a comparator field was supplied.
- unsupported_unit: source system/code does not identify a UCUM-coded quantity or a supported HL7 TAB/CAP count.
- drug_unresolved: no standard drug concept was resolved.
- missing_drug_evidence: formulation and strength evidence is unavailable.
- incomplete_drug_evidence: required vocabulary evidence is missing or invalid.
- ambiguous_drug_evidence: more than one dose form exists, or more than one strength exists for a conversion requiring strength. Direct counts allow combination products.
- missing_classification: the selected drug's concept class is unavailable.
- unsupported_drug_class: the drug is outside Clinical Drug or Branded Drug, including quantified products and packs.
- unsupported_dose_form: the dose form has no supported classification for these policies.
- unsupported_strength: strength does not establish the selected policy, including missing, non-positive, non-finite, or conflicting values or an absent/unsupported denominator basis for volume conversion.
- unit_mismatch: the source neither matches a validated vocabulary-backed strength unit nor converts within the documented supported unit groups, or an explicit count disagrees with the selected tablet/capsule form.
- unsupported_fraction: a fixed-form count is not whole units or multiples of one-half or one-third.
- invalid_result: arithmetic does not produce a positive finite result.

result.description: Same numeric value as the linked row's quantity.

fhir2omop_QuantityUnitConversion.description:
Successful case-sensitive UCUM conversion of the source magnitude into a
supported strength unit. Present only when the unit code changes. The result
is an intermediate value, not the linked row's quantity, and can remain
present when a later policy check omits that quantity.

result.description: Original source magnitude converted to result_unit, before strength arithmetic.

fhir2omop_QuantityUnit.description: Vocabulary concept identifying the measurement unit. For fixed_dose_form_count results this is the RxNorm dose form being counted; for clinical_injection_ingredient_amount results it is the UCUM ingredient unit. Strength units use UCUM. Codes are vocabulary-native and concept IDs belong to vocab_version.

fhir2omop_QuantityEvidence.description: Available selected-drug, dose-form, and single-ingredient strength evidence. Missing or ambiguous evidence is not replaced with an arbitrary value. On successful outcomes these fields explain the named policy's calculation.

fhir2omop_QuantityStrength.description:
Single-ingredient strength evidence: amount is ingredient per fixed unit;
numerator/denominator describe concentration. Missing raw values remain
absent without defaults. denominator_basis records the interpretation of
the denominator. Box-size/refill arithmetic is not applied.

fhir2omop_QuantityDenominatorBasis.description:
Interpretation of the vocabulary denominator, retained for audit even when
conversion is omitted. PER_UNIT denotes a normalized per-unit concentration;
QUANTIFIED_TOTAL supplies an explicit product total. NOT_APPLICABLE and
UNKNOWN supply no basis value. Only PER_UNIT supports injection volume
conversion. Omitted when no basis is supplied.

value.description: Original numeric denominator-basis value, including zero or negative values retained for audit. Successful volume-to-ingredient conversion requires kind PER_UNIT and value 1.

device_exposure_id.description: Request-local exposure identity, distinct from physical or model device identity.

device_concept_id.description: Validated standard Device concept; 0 for missing or unresolved type evidence.

device_exposure_start_date.description: Source use start at day precision; absent when unknown or unusable.

device_exposure_start_datetime.description: Source local wall-clock start, without UTC offset; absent for date-only input.

device_exposure_end_date.description: Explicit source end; absent when unknown or unusable.

device_exposure_end_datetime.description: Source local wall-clock end, without UTC offset; absent for date-only input.

device_type_concept_id.description: Coarse source provenance; DeviceUseStatement uses generic EHR 32817.

unique_device_id.description: Unambiguous supplied UDI-DI; competing values remain in source context.

production_id.description: Unset; supplied production components and carriers remain in source context.

quantity.description: Default 1 when quantity evidence is absent; otherwise omitted. See device_exposure_contexts.quantity_basis.

provider_id.description: Compatible explicit performer on routed rows; absent for DeviceUseStatement and reporting-only actors.

visit_occurrence_id.description: Explicit emitted same-patient visit for routed rows; absent for DeviceUseStatement.

visit_detail_id.description: Explicit same-patient component for routed rows, with its overarching visit_occurrence_id; absent for DeviceUseStatement.

device_source_value.description: Original selected type or clinical code, or supplied text; never a resource/inventory identifier.

device_source_concept_id.description: Original source concept when established by vocabulary resolution; otherwise 0.

unit_source_value.description: Unset; unsupported clinical units remain in source context.

fhir2omop_DeviceExposureContext.description: Shared evidence and quantity explanation for all device exposures derived from one source record. Matching or absent resource identifiers do not merge distinct source records.

exposures.description: Links to all device exposure rows derived from this source record.

quantity_basis.description: Applies to every linked exposure. default_absent_count identifies the default quantity of 1. unsupported_supplied_evidence identifies omitted quantity due to supplied clinical quantity evidence, including null or malformed numeric fields. UNSUPPORTED diagnostics identify the source paths.

evidence.description: Original supplied source values with source paths. Device detail paths begin with device.; other paths refer to the clinical source resource. Timing precision, offsets, schedules, statuses, relationships, UDI carriers, and unsupported quantities are preserved here.

device_exposure_id.description: Request-local ID of a row in tables.device_exposure.

event_index.description: Zero-based index in this context's supplied timingTiming.event evidence, including unusable events retained as partial rows. Omitted for other timing forms.

value.description: Original supplied JSON value, including null or malformed source evidence.

specimen_id.description: Request-local generated row identity; distinct from specimen_source_id.

person_id.description: Explicitly resolved top-level Patient in this response.

specimen_concept_id.description: Material validated against Specimen; 0 for supplied unmapped material or absent material. Absence has a linked type diagnostic and no mapping/summary count; supplied unmapped material has a vocabulary mapping outcome.

specimen_type_concept_id.description: 32817 (EHR record provenance), independent of material and availability.

specimen_date.description:
Collection date from collectedDateTime or collectedPeriod.start at day
precision. Missing, partial, invalid, or conflicting timing leaves it absent
with a linked diagnostic; callers must handle required-date completion for
CDM loading.

specimen_datetime.description: Collection local wall-clock time, only when supplied; no fabricated time or offset conversion.

quantity.description: Exact nonnegative collection.quantity.value, without comparator or numeric conversion.

unit_concept_id.description: Valid standard Unit concept for coded UCUM; 0 for supplied unmapped units, null for absence.

anatomic_site_concept_id.description: Valid standard Spec Anatomic Site concept for a coded site; 0 for a supplied unmapped or text-only site, null for absence. Text-only sites retain source text without a concept suggestion.

specimen_source_id.description: Resource id, first valued identifier, accession value, then fullUrl. All source identities and selection path are in specimen_source_contexts. Kept verbatim; downstream loaders must handle CDM varchar(50) limits.

specimen_source_value.description: Selected bare material code or source text.

unit_source_value.description: Exact Quantity.code when supplied, otherwise Quantity.unit.

anatomic_site_source_value.description: Selected bare bodySite code or source text.

status.description: Original FHIR Specimen.status for this emitted row, describing sample availability or suitability. Omitted when no status was supplied; no availability is inferred. This is source metadata, not an OMOP disease-status concept.

source_id_path.description: Selected source path (id, identifier[index].value, accessionIdentifier.value, or fullUrl); absent if no source identity was supplied.

fhir2omop_SpecimenCollectionTiming.description: Supplied FHIR timing retained verbatim for audit and downstream completion. This is response provenance, not a CDM table or an inferred collection date.

collected_date_time.description: Original collection.collectedDateTime, including partial precision, invalid text, or timezone offset.

received_time.description: Original receivedTime, never substituted for collection timing.

selected_path.description: collection.collectedDateTime or collection.collectedPeriod.start when specimen_date was populated; omitted when no date could safely be selected.

end.description: Original collectedPeriod.end, retained without using it as collection start.

fhir2omop_MappingEntry.description:
Outcome for one source coding or supplied text, including source information
retained without resolution. omop_table and omop_id identify the emitted row;
omop_field identifies its populated concept column when applicable. A field
can have multiple coding entries sharing one resolution outcome. selected
identifies the source coding used in the linked row's source-value column.

omop_id.description:
The id of the OMOP row this coding produced (e.g. `condition_occurrence_id`),
within `omop_table`. A resource with multiple codings yields one entry
per coding, all sharing this id.

omop_field.description: The OMOP concept-ID field populated from this source coding, such as `condition_concept_id`, `route_concept_id`, or `race_concept_id`. Omitted when the entry preserves source information without populating a row column.

source_coding_index.description: Zero-based index of this coding in its originating specialty entry's coding array. When specialty audit is available, it also identifies the corresponding resolution.specialty_resolution.coding_results outcome. Present only for coded specialty mappings, including empty Coding objects; these mappings retain the supplied coding order.

target_code.description:
The standard concept's own code: the source code itself for an
ALREADY_STANDARD row, the standard concept's code for a MAPPED row,
or the suggested code for an UNCHECKED row. Omitted for UNMAPPED
rows.

mapping_status.description:
ALREADY_STANDARD: the source coding is already an OMOP standard concept.
MAPPED: coding or descriptive text resolved to a standard concept.
UNCHECKED: a suggestion is unvalidated and concept ID remains 0.
UNMAPPED: no valid target was selected, or information was retained without
resolution as explained in note.

Specialty entries report the selected field-level outcome; independent
coding support remains in resolution.specialty_resolution.coding_results.

selected.description:
Whether this coding supplies the row's source value; always present. False
for alternate codings, text-only rows, specialties, and entries without a
corresponding column. For demographics, marks the code determining the
Person field or race Observation, even without a resolved concept.
Race/ethnicity null flavors, conflicting inputs, overridden Patient gender,
and race categories not determining the field are unselected.

note.description:
Explanatory context for source interpretation, table placement, unmapped
outcomes, and values retained without a corresponding row column.
Demographic notes identify the source and why a supplied value was not used.
Notes are human-readable text, not stable identifiers; use selected,
mapping_status, and resolution fields for programmatic decisions.

fhir2omop_SemanticMappingResult.description:
Semantic-mapping outcome for a supported concept field; present when
inference was attempted. The containing MappingEntry supplies row/field
links. Multiple coding entries can share one field outcome; group by
omop_table, omop_id, and omop_field when processing it. Original source
coding is preserved; text-only inputs do not invent coding.

status.description: MAPPED when semantic mapping selected a validated standard OMOP concept; UNMAPPED when no standard concept was selected.

vocab_version.description: OMOP vocabulary release selected for this mapping.

reason_code.description:
Why semantic mapping did not select a standard concept. Present when
`status` is UNMAPPED; omitted when `status` is MAPPED.

- `MISSING_DESCRIPTION`: no usable source text or coding display was supplied.
- `NO_VALID_SUGGESTION`: semantic validation completed without accepting a candidate as having the same clinical meaning as the source description.
- `AMBIGUOUS`: a unique standard concept could not be selected from the possible matches.
- `INVALID_TARGET`: the suggested code is not an active standard OMOP concept valid for the destination field.

The linked concept field retains ID 0. An unresolved result-value field
does not unset the row's primary concept.

fhir2omop_MappingResolution.description:
Field-level outcome and provenance shared by that field's coding entries.
Paths describe the selected concept, not independent mappings of alternates.
Present for semantic attempts; omitted for source information retained
without resolution, including text-only sites, units lacking supported
coding, and result values retained without a corresponding row column.
Allergy evidence can retain source targets that were not selected as
substance values.

source_text.description: Explicit source text used to select a specialty concept. Its vocabulary spelling or full preferred term is retained separately in paths[].matched_text.

status.description: Vocabulary resolution outcome. Any outcome other than RESOLVED yields mapping_status UNMAPPED and concept ID 0 while retaining an otherwise usable row.

reason_code.description:
Machine-readable explanation for an unresolved mapping, when available:

- `NO_SOURCE_CODE`: no source coding was supplied.
- `NO_OMOP_SOURCE_CONCEPT`: no OMOP source concept matches the supplied coding.
- `NO_STANDARD_MAP`: no usable standard OMOP mapping was found for the supplied coding.
- `AMBIGUOUS`: multiple candidate concepts could not be disambiguated.
- `DOMAIN_MISMATCH`: candidate standard concepts do not match the domain required by the linked OMOP field.
- `UNSUPPORTED_SYSTEM`: the source code system is unsupported.
- `UNSUPPORTED_CODE`: the source code is unsupported for the linked OMOP field.
- `CONFLICTING_ALLERGY_EVIDENCE`: allergy source meanings or context conflict.
- `UNSUPPORTED_ALLERGY_SOURCE`: no supported allergy source meaning was established.
- `UNSUPPORTED_ALLERGY_CONTEXT`: the source context has no supported finding policy.
- `UNSUPPORTED_SOURCE_MEANING`: a known source concept has no supported allergy interpretation.

Unknown reason codes are omitted; `status` still records the outcome.

via.description:
How the selected concept was reached: DIRECT uses vocabulary identity or
Maps to; UMLS_BRIDGE uses a shared UMLS concept; CONTEXTUAL uses allergy
source context. Specialty text routes identify a concept name (CONCEPT_NAME),
English synonym (CONCEPT_SYNONYM), English UMLS string (UMLS_STRING), or
NUCC preferred label (NUCC_LABEL). Omitted when unavailable or no concept
was selected; paths retain matching evidence.

paths.description: Mapping paths to the selected concept, in response order. Omitted when unavailable or no concept was selected.

truncated.description: Present and true when candidate matches were truncated during resolution. Absence means no truncation was reported.

fhir2omop_AllergyMappingResolution.description:
Contextual finding policy and original coding interpretation, shared by the
field's mappings. When domain-based placement supplies a result outside
contextual coverage, this object retains the contextual no-match while the
enclosing resolution describes placement. Missing mechanism, certainty, or
activity is not inferred from source statuses. incomplete describes source-interpretation
coverage; inspect finding and substance mappings independently for resolution.

method.description: Direct vocabulary finding mapping, contextual finding selection, selection using a derived category, or no contextual finding selected.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason for the contextual policy outcome, when available.

type.description: Supplied FHIR type; omitted when absent.

categories.description: Supplied FHIR category values, preserving their order and repeats; null primitive placeholders are omitted. Empty when no category value is supplied.

clinical_status.description: Supplied clinical-status codings; omitted when none are available.

verification_status.description: Supplied verification-status codings; omitted when absent. A retained unconfirmed statement is not promoted to confirmed.

date_source.description: Source element selected by the existing date rule, including when its value has partial precision. Omitted when no usable or partial date is supplied; no date is invented.

effective_categories.description: Distinct sorted categories used by the contextual policy, including any reviewed derivation.

category_derived.description: Whether reviewed vocabulary evidence supplied an absent category. This can also accompany a direct finding.

incomplete.description: Whether some coding evidence was uninterpretable or outside policy coverage.

information_loss.description: Explanations of specificity omitted by the selected finding or published mapping. Source coding and context remain in the audit metadata.

fhir2omop_AllergyCodingEvidence.description: Interpretation of an original allergy code. Concept IDs are vocabulary evidence, not a selected value or a claim that a product's complete meaning fits one value field.

source_concept_id.description: Original coding's OMOP source identity, when known. This evidence does not override the linked row's source-concept semantics.

standard_concept_ids.description: Standard targets reported for the original code. Empty when none are available; multiple targets do not choose one ingredient as the complete substance value.

fhir2omop_SpecialtyResolution.description:
Optional fallback decision and independent coding outcomes for one specialty
entry. The enclosing resolution describes the selected result; unsupported
codings can coexist with successful explicit-text resolution. Omitted when
audit evidence is unavailable; omission does not change the field outcome.

text_fallback_reason.description:
NO_CODINGS identifies ordinary text-only resolution. INVALID_CODING
means a missing code or missing/malformed system blocks fallback.
SUPPORTED_SYSTEM_PRESENT blocks fallback even when a supported code
does not resolve. NO_SPECIALTY_TEXT means complete unsupported
codings lack explicit nonblank text. UNSUPPORTED_SYSTEMS_ONLY means
complete unsupported codings permit a text attempt; the attempt may
still be unresolved or ambiguous.

coding_results.description: Independent outcome of every supplied coding in its original order, including empty or incomplete objects. Empty for text-only specialties. Each mapping's source_coding_index identifies its corresponding outcome.

coding_index.description: Zero-based index in the originating specialty entry's coding array.

system_support.description: Whether the coding system is supported for resolution, unsupported, or missing/malformed. A missing code can still have a supported or unsupported system.

status.description: This coding's independent outcome before combining the entry's evidence.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable explanation when available; omitted for successful codings and unknown reasons.

fhir2omop_MappingPath.description:
Provenance path to the selected concept, starting at an input, UMLS sibling,
or policy concept. Its source ID can differ from the original input's OMOP
identity and must not replace that input's source-concept column.

mapping_status.description: Path outcome. MAPPED denotes an OMOP Maps to crosswalk; POLICY_MAPPED identifies an explicit vocabulary mapping policy and is retained here even though the enclosing mapping_status reports MAPPED.

source_concept_id.description: OMOP concept at the start of this mapping path.

source_code.description: Code of the path's source concept in its OMOP vocabulary.

cui.description: Shared UMLS concept identifier for UMLS_BRIDGE, UMLS_STRING, or NUCC_LABEL, when supplied.

sab.description: UMLS sibling source abbreviation, such as NUCCHCPT for NUCC routes.

matched_text.description: Actual vocabulary string matched by a specialty text layer. For NUCC_LABEL this is the full original preferred term, including its grouping prefix; source_text retains the supplied text.

fhir2omop_Summary.description:
Resolution outcome counts and the share not already standard. Each evaluated
field contributes one outcome even when several codings produce mappings.

| Included outcomes | Counting unit |
| --- | --- |
| Primary clinical concepts, specimen material/sites, supplied Quantity units on Measurement/Observation/Specimen, coded Observation results on Measurement/Observation, allergy substance values, Encounter classifications, Address.country, CMS Place of Service, and recorded Practitioner gender | Each evaluated field |
| Coded medication/Immunization routes, including context on other destinations | Each source-selected route; report-only alternates do not add outcomes |
| Provider specialties | Each distinct input per provider |
| Patient demographics | Each selected Person field or emitted race Observation; conflicting values count once as unmapped |

Absent specimen material/sites and units do not count. Demographic null
flavors, Patient gender other/unknown or overridden by birth sex, and race
categories not determining a field are reported only in mappings.
Observation values retained without a corresponding row column, quantity
audits, and visit compatibility assessments do not add resolution outcomes.
Dropped resources do not count; indexed rows remain included in codes_*
and off_vocab_rate.

codes_already_standard.description: Resolution outcomes already a standard OMOP concept (ALREADY_STANDARD).

codes_normalized.description: Resolution outcomes mapped or suggested to a standard concept (MAPPED or UNCHECKED).

codes_unmapped.description: Resolution outcomes with no standard concept valid for the destination selected (UNMAPPED).

rows_for_review.description: Length of the rows_for_review index; each row counts once even with multiple retention reasons. codes_* and off_vocab_rate include all shaped rows; dropped resources do not count.

off_vocab_rate.description: Share of resolution outcomes not already standard ((normalized + unmapped) / total).

fhir2omop_ReferenceDiagnostic.description:
Explains why source data or a reference could not be used. omop_table and
omop_id identify the affected emitted row, not a rejected target; both are
omitted when no affected row is emitted. Multiple source resources can link
to one row. IDs are local to this response.

omop_table.description: Table containing the affected row in this response. Present together with omop_id when that row is emitted.

omop_id.description: Primary key of the affected row within omop_table in this response. Present together with omop_table when that row is emitted.

path.description:
Source field or diagnostic label. Demographic labels include
`extension:birthsex` and `extension:ethnicity`; provider identity labels
are `name`, `gender`, `birthDate`, and `identifier`. For Encounters,
`class/type` identifies class/type disagreement and `type` identifies
conflicting type classifications. Joint rules can use slash-separated
paths such as `whenHandedOver/daysSupply`.

reference.description: The supplied Reference.reference value, when present.

outcome.description:
- UNRESOLVED: required source data is missing, or a supported reference cannot
  resolve to a supplied resource or emitted target.
- AMBIGUOUS: a reference or identifier does not identify a unique target.
- CONFLICTING: source values or relationships disagree or require review
  under the mapping policy.
- UNSUPPORTED: a source form/type or relationship cannot be fully represented
  or assessed under the supported policy.

reason explains the effect on the row or link. An outcome alone does not
imply that the resource was dropped; partial rows or grouping can be retained.

reason.description:
Explanation of the condition and its effect on mapping. Resource-specific
reason codes can be followed by `; ` and explanatory text; match these
codes as prefixes rather than whole strings. Collection timing uses
specimen_collection_date_missing, specimen_collection_date_partial,
specimen_collection_date_unusable, or specimen_collection_multiple_forms.
Dispensing timing uses medication_dispense_handover_missing,
medication_dispense_handover_partial, or medication_dispense_handover_unusable.
medication_dispense_handover_before_preparation identifies conflicting
handover/preparation timing;
medication_dispense_end_date_absent identifies an unset exposure end.

name.description: Display name for the FHIR provider

description.description: Optional description of the FHIR provider
description.example: Epic sandbox environment for testing

base_url.description: Base URL of the FHIR server

fhir_provider_FhirProviderTemplate.description:
Full FHIR provider configuration returned for non-sandbox providers.
`auth_configs` and `last_updated` are always populated, which is how
list responses distinguish this shape from `FhirProviderSandboxInfo`.

fhir_provider_AuthMethod.description:
Authentication method for the FHIR provider. Only one authentication method can be used at a time,
but these can be rotated on the FHIR Provider as needed.

**Scope behavior by auth method:**
- `client_secret`, `jwt`, `on_behalf_of`: Scopes are included in the OAuth token request.
  They can be configured using the `role` or `scopes` field. If neither is specified, provider-specific
  default scopes derived from a default role are used. Roles grant access across all FHIR resource
  types, but the exact scope format varies by EHR — see the `Role` schema for details.
- `google_healthcare`: Uses a fixed Google Cloud Healthcare scope. Specifying `role` or `scopes` will
  return an error.
- `token_passthrough`: The caller provides their own bearer token via the X-Phenoml-Fhir-Provider header
  as one or more comma-separated {fhir_provider_id}:{oauth2_token} pairs. Specifying `role` or `scopes`
  will return an error. This is the recommended mode for providers like Meditech where the bearer token
  is typically obtained outside PhenoML.
- `none`: No authentication is performed. Specifying `role` or `scopes` will return an error.

For the `on_behalf_of` authentication method, you must also provide the Patient or Practitioner reference
in the X-Phenoml-On-Behalf-Of header in the format Patient/{uuid} or Practitioner/{uuid}. This only works
for the medplum provider currently.

More on the authentication headers and how to structure them can be found in the FHIR Proxy, Tools and
Agent documentation.

fhir_provider_Role.description:
Predefined access level that maps to provider-specific OAuth scopes.
Cannot be specified together with `scopes`. Only applicable to
`client_secret`, `jwt`, and `on_behalf_of` auth methods.

Roles apply across **all FHIR resource types** (e.g., Patient, Observation,
Condition, etc.) — they are not limited to a single resource. The server
resolves each role to the appropriate system-level scopes for the provider:
- `admin`: Full CRUD access (create, read, update, delete, search) on all resources
- `read`: Read and search access on all resources
- `write`: Create, update, and delete access on all resources (no read)

**The exact scopes generated depend on the provider**, because each EHR uses a
different SMART on FHIR version or scope format:
- **Epic**: SMART v2 scopes (e.g., `system/*.cruds` for admin)
- **Cerner**: Cerner-specific SMART v2 scopes with per-resource grants for the
  subset of resources Cerner supports
- **Athenahealth**: USCDI SMART v2 scopes with explicit per-resource grants
  (e.g., `system/Patient.rs`, `system/Observation.rs`, etc.)
- **Elation**: SMART v1 scopes (e.g., `system/*.read` for read)
- **Medplum, Phenostore**: SMART v2 scopes

If neither `role` nor `scopes` is specified, the provider-specific default
role is used (typically `read`; `admin` for Medplum/sandbox).

If the generated scopes don't match what your EHR expects, use the `scopes`
field to specify exact scopes instead.

Canvas does not support system-level roles — use `scopes` directly.
Google Healthcare, HAPI, Meditech, and `none`/`token_passthrough`
auth methods do not use scopes at all.
